title: Fix animation shorthand property without name output
author: sapphi-red
summary: Fixes `animation` serialization when the name is `none`: master throws away every other component. The fix is still needed on master, but the PR also changes minified `animation: none` to `animation:1` and rewrites existing expectations (`none, none` -> `1,1`), which needs justification or reverting.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI: `.a{animation:2s linear infinite}` -> `.a{animation:none}` (duration, easing and iteration count dropped; observable once another rule sets animation-name, or via computed style). `animation:1s infinite` -> `animation:none`. No comments or reviews in two years; base is 9e04c01, so it may need a rebase. The `1` minification and the changed test outputs are a choice for the reviewer (CLAUDE.md: changed expectations need justification).
